items.title: How the Latest AI Leap Is Disrupting Business Models
items.summary: A developer one-shots Photoshop with a Claude subscription, AI-accelerated crackers jailbreak the PS5, and mashed-up AAA games are suddenly a one-day project. The Astra and Opus 5.5 jump has turned decompiling and reconstituting software from a legal curiosity into a mass capability — and today's episode is about how Adobe, Epic, Xbox, Bumble's new owners, and even David's Bridal are responding to business models being torn up in real time.
items.whyItMatters: Big-lab product changes tend to become the new baseline fast, so they are worth tracking even when the launch sounds incremental.

items.title: Why carriers block legitimate business texts and what works instead
items.summary:
When a legitimate business text fails to arrive, the sender usually blames the carrier. The carrier usually has a reason. In practice, carrier filtering responds to recognizable risks: high spam volume, rising complaint rates, and messages that do not match the brand or campaign described during registration.
